Consider this joint distribution for random variables $U$ and $V$, written in hierarchical form:

$$
\begin{aligned}
U&\sim\text{Gamma}\left(\alpha,\,\beta\right)\\
V\mid U=u&\sim \text{Exponential}(u).
\end{aligned}
$$


a. Sketch the joint range of $(U,\, V)$.
a. What is the joint density of the random pair $(U,\, V)$?
a. What is the marginal density of $V$?
a. What is the density of $U$ conditional on the event $V=v$? Is it recognizable?
